deviation: The draft adds automatic 12-month renewals, where Arcadia's standard has none. The 90-day notice window and 12-month term match the fallback, but the draft has no cap on renewal price increases, which the playbook requires (5%) if auto-renewal is accepted. Without a cap, the supplier could raise prices at each renewal.
suggested_text:
This Agreement does not renew automatically. Any extension requires a written agreement signed by both parties.

Fallback, only if auto-renewal must be accepted: This Agreement renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives at least 90 days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term. Fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than 5% over the fees in effect during the immediately preceding term.
